candidates.title: Prepare a safe workflow repair plan

demandEvidence.chore: Safely repair an existing self-hosted workflow without unintended changes.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: We need guidance on safely repairing an existing workflow in self-hosted n8n 2.30.4 , without risking unintended changes.

ease.reason: A beginner could turn operator-supplied workflow details into a proposed review checklist; no implementation reference supports actual workflow repair.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: n8n consultants might charge for repair planning; this request establishes no buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week test can draft a checklist from synthetic or operator-supplied examples, but n8n version-specific repair remains untested.

autonomy.reason: The tool could prepare a plan, but a qualified operator must inspect changes and apply them; no supported execution capability is attached.

evidence.reason: The fresh request names safe repair of an existing self-hosted workflow but gives no specifics, frequency or corroborating implementation source.

candidates.reason: Below threshold: a bounded repair checklist is conceivable, but no relevant implementation source is attached and an operator must make and verify all changes.

candidates.title: Summarize investor monitoring signals

demandEvidence.chore: Monitor a shortlist of company domains and alert when simultaneous operational signals appear.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: monitors a shortlist of company domains and alerts you only when a company shows simultaneous operational

ease.reason: A beginner could mock a signal summary from manually supplied sample observations, but no implementation reference supports monitoring.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: small investment teams might pay for signal summaries; this builder post does not establish a customer need or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can summarize supplied examples, while actual signal sources and the incomplete criteria remain unspecified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed loop could format supplied signals, but people must judge relevance and no monitoring or alert capability is documented here.

evidence.reason: The excerpt states a shortlist monitoring and alert workflow, but its trigger detail is cut off and it is a maker report rather than validated demand.

candidates.reason: Below threshold: the excerpt describes a maker-built workflow rather than an unmet request, and the alert condition is incomplete.

rejected.title: Reduce product-building and customer-acquisition time
rejected.reason: The post says product building and customer acquisition consume more time, but specifies no concrete subtask, inputs or repeatable workflow; proposing an automation would invent the chore.

rejected.title: Screen dyslexia risk in preschoolers
rejected.reason: The only supplied evidence is a product title for screening dyslexia risk in preschoolers. It does not identify a safe bounded administrative chore; risk screening would involve sensitive educational/health judgments, so no experiment is proposed.

rejected.title: Find referral and sales partners
rejected.reason: The excerpt describes a provider offering AI-agent scoping, delivery and support and the title seeks partners. It establishes no specific unmet buyer chore for a tool; inventing partner discovery automation would go beyond the evidence.

rejected.title: Prepare a safe workflow repair plan
rejected.reason: Below threshold: only a proposed checklist from operator-supplied details is supportable; no implementation source documents safe workflow repair, and an operator must inspect and apply changes.

rejected.title: Summarize investor monitoring signals
rejected.reason: Below threshold and weak demand evidence: the source is a maker report, with an incomplete alert condition, not an expressed unmet chore or validated demand.

steps.message: Assessed all five assigned discussions. Two concrete workflow concepts received provisional five-criterion ratings but remain below the 6/10 threshold; the other three lack a sufficiently supported safe, bounded chore. No post proposed.
